overall_reason: Executed evidence (129 TLC checks over old/proposed definitions, 23 Go probes on old/new code (17 new, 6 old)) confirms the initial judgment with four corrections: (1) ConfigurationTransitionSafety must not exempt every id-0 entry, or raft-initiated duplicate LeaveJoint entries are hidden; (2) NoUnexpectedFatal must accept the test-required 'removed all voters' refusal; (3) EffectContract must also require that non-refused changes do not panic; (4) TypeOK needs joint well-formedness. V1 requirement changes (demotion, zero-voter refusal, idempotent removal) and joint-consensus obligations (two-majority quorums, single auto-leave) are encoded; bug candidates B1-B3 remain detectable by kept or strengthened properties; B4/B5 are unresolved for lack of requirement text.
